nodes.label: ADR 0002 - PostgreSQL, PostGIS and Initial Search
nodes.rationale: Less initial infrastructure, strong consistency between listings and search, good geographic query support, simpler local migrations/tests. Trade-offs: weaker ranking/typo tolerance than dedicated engines, index/query-plan attention needed; Typesense/Meilisearch/OpenSearch deferred to a later phase.
